notes.title: The full version of Darkchaser: Battletide is released!
notes.content:
Adventurers, the full version of Darkchaser: Battletide was officially released on December 5, 2024, at 18:00 PST. Thank you for your play and support since the early access! Players who already own the EA version of Darkchaser: Battletide do not need to purchase again, just update to experience the full version.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/b5977579f981a40676bcd9f971f1be762983ce4b.png
Play as a hero in a monster-infested world, using various skills and relics to arm yourself and battle countless enemies. Join online battles, challenge other players, and grow stronger through levels!

※The full version update includes:
1. New PvE gameplay: Arcane mode
2. New skill enhancements for Arcane mode
3. New achievements for Arcane mode
4. New Arcane mode gallery
5. Adjusted shop item effects in Arcane mode, differing from standard PvE mode
6. Fixed several combat-related bugs

[About Game Price]
The full version of Darkchaser: Battletide will be priced at $4.49 this month. We will have a launch sale from December 5 to December 18, 2024, PST, with the price reduced to $3.37.
Please note:
Due to the development and improvement of game content, the price of the full version of Darkchaser: Battletide will be adjusted on January 1, 2025, from $4.49 to $4.99, and there will be $5.49 in USA due to the tax. 
Don't forget to purchase the game before then!

The full version includes:
-13 characters with unique talents
-Three different game modes
-250+ relics with different effects
-50+ skills
-25+ monsters with different styles
-Three selectable difficulty levels
-And Arcane mode - Boosted Skill, Random Talents!（This mode will be continuously updated, stay tuned!）

[About the Arcane mode]
After this full version update, the new game mode - Arcane mode is available!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/75c58c18e5b1a641cd58dd4cbc9d1b4d9a5dbc15.png
[Skill Enhancement]
In Arcane mode, all skills can be enhanced through [Embed], and some skills will have exclusive ultimate effects!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/54807f21380f10d801a3096a41ce3db36171ea50.png
[Crossroad Events]
When entering a level, there is a chance to encounter [crossroads], leading to different areas and obtaining more treasures!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/0a6f581c0ef9192abd92572fd1d147ec28b336d6.png
[Random Talents]
In Arcane mode, the character's talent tree disappears, replaced by random talent cards, allowing for more powerful builds!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/7306c1b3d57a8b3add52fc5bd73c5aad982d3910.png

notes.title: Update roadmap is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The update roadmap for Darkchaser: Battletide is out! It shows the major updates we've implemented during EA and our plans for the near future. We're also gearing up for the official release, so make sure to follow us on social media and join our community to get the latest game news!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/aa1c5d596b0739396410f2eab47bb54738e2b812.png

Here's what we've done and what's coming up:

Implemented:

Character Talent Update: We've revamped and adjusted character talents to enhance strategic depth and playability.
Controller Support & Optimization: The game now fully supports controllers and has been optimized for a smooth experience.
Multilingual Support: We've added support for more languages, so more players can enjoy the game in their native tongue.
New PVP Mode: A brand new PVP mode is live, come and challenge other players!

Coming Soon:

New Boss Skills: We're adding more skills to bosses for extra fun challenges!
Building Update: New building features are in the works, offering more strategic options.
Planned Content: We're cooking up some new stuff, so stay tuned.

The full version of Darkchaser: Battletide is coming soon, with more exciting content waiting for you! We'll keep listening to player feedback and continue to improve the game experience. Thanks for all your support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: Darkchaser: Battletide - PvP mode is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,
Greetings!

In this update, Darkchaser: Battletide introduces a new PvP mode ! Adventurers can now invite others to duel in the battle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/2f6a8f9704f8bd8ee7ff8bb1f465c6be50768346.png

About this mode:
After entering the game, players can create a unique link in Multiplayer Mode and invite another adventurer to join the game for a showdown.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/9c54fd093cb284881cb7211e7926fc1545f2c26a.png

Once inside, the screen splits to show each player's battle. Adventurers gain extra skills to hinder opponents, slow them down, or spawn more monsters in their area!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/50c7a72e074deae468f7e11882d2cd6d901684e0.png

In this mode, each adventurer's shop offers relics that can affect the other player, turning every choice into an obstacle for your opponent!
Can you make it to the end in such a HARMONIOUS and FRIENDLY game?

Update details:
※ Adjustments
1. New multiplayer competitive mode
2. New relics for multiplayer mode
3. Added view height settings
4. Improved controller logic

※ Bug Fixes
1. Fixed issue with unlocking achievements on difficulty 3
2. Fixed shop purchase issues in certain cases

The battletide rises. Adventurers, call your friends, enter the battle, and experience the new competitive mode. Embrace endless battles!

| Official Website | Facebook | X | Discord |

notes.title: Darkchaser: Battletide Early Access is now live!
notes.content:
Darkchaser: Battletide kicks off its Early Access on May 8, 19:00 Pacific Standard Time. Transform into a hero and enter a world ravaged by monsters, arm yourself with various skills and relics, and engage in fierce battles against countless enemies. Grow stronger through challenges!

After the game's release and during the Infinite Replay Festival, we'll also have developer live streams from time to time. Don't miss out!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/9b899d72c8de66c2dc0c031e76abde657ef16c85.png

[About the Game Price]
Darkchaser: Battletide Early Access is priced at $4.49. We'll have a launch discount from May 8 to May 22 Pacific Time, lowering the price to $4.04.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884590/DarkchaserBattletide/

Additionally, our Early Access is expected to last 4 months. You can wait to play the full version of the game after Early Access ends. However, please understand that the game's price may increase after Early Access.

[About the Early Access Version]
We chose the Early Access model to get player feedback and suggestions earlier. This helps us understand player needs directly, allowing us to focus our development efforts on what players care about most.

For language support, the early access launch already includes Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English. We'll be rolling out more supported languages soon, so stay tuned!

The early access version includes:
- 12 unique characters and their talent trees
- Over 50 different skills
- More than 170 relics with various effects
- Three difficulty levels and an endless mode
- 16 types of regular enemies, 7 elite enemies, and 3 powerful lords

After this early access release, we hope you'll head to our game community or official channels to share your feedback, helping us improve the game for an even better experience down the line.

| Official Website | Facebook | X | Discord |

notes.title: DarkChaser: Battletide will launch its Early Access on May 8th on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers, thank you for your attention! DarkChaser: Battletide will launch its Early Access on May 9th, don't miss out! 

Early Access starts at
7:00 PM Pacific Time on May 8, 2024. 

The initial EA version includes:
 - 12 characters with unique traits and their own talent trees
 - Over 50 different skills 
 - More than 170 relics with various effects
 - Three different difficulty levels and an endless mode
 - 16 types of regular enemies, 5 elite enemies, and 3 powerful lords

Poison, fire, ice, summoning, martial arts, and other styles will help you spray bullets and tear through enemy waves. In DarkChaser: Battletide, every adventurer can find their own way to play. Join us now, claim your profession and relics, crush wave after wave of enemies, and become the strongest adventurer! 
The adventure is about to begin, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

Steam store page link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884590/ 
Official website: https://db.luckycalf.com/


In the EA version, there are many aspects of the game that still need polishing and improvement, please be understanding. 
Furthermore, during the EA version experience, if adventurers encounter any gameplay issues, you can go to the game community or official channel for feedback, and we will record and deal with it immediately!
